countedBy: lane (opus) from the rectified Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas w02-308 (recording_2025-06-19_06-21-49_00258) and w07-307 / w06-307, 2026-11-01; not a blind count

facades.name: Turfpakhuizen front, NE gable (NW, point gable)
facades.note: The single warehouse left in w02-308: basket arch and two small lights, storeys 1 and 2 narrow-wide-narrow (the wide one shuttered), one wide window in the gable, a small light at the top.

facades.name: Turfpakhuizen front, double gable (NW, truncated under the balustrade)
facades.note: The double warehouse in the middle of w02-308: two basket arches and two small lights, storeys 1 and 2 eight axes, gable storey six, two wide windows at the top.

facades.name: Turfpakhuizen front, SW gable (NW, point gable)
facades.note: The single warehouse right in w02-308, mirror of the NE one.

facades.name: Huiszittenhuis front, NE wing (NW, three axes)
facades.note: Left of the risalit in w07-307: souterrain, bel-etage and upper storey, three axes each, the middle souterrain window arched; one dormer with a round pediment above.

facades.name: Huiszittenhuis front, risalit (NW, pediment)
facades.note: The 0.25 m risalit: narrow flanking windows (about 0.8 m) around the wide middle axis (front door under the perron, the light over it, wide windows above), the oculus in the pediment.

facades.name: Huiszittenhuis front, SW wing (NW, three axes)
facades.note: Right of the risalit in w07-307: souterrain, bel-etage and upper storey, three axes each. One dormer with a round pediment above (w07-307); the model leaves it out (it sinks behind the wall on the 3DBAG roof).
